name: Titan Streamer
description: Firmware for the Titan wearable: streams raw PPG (HRM-raw) + accelerometer over Bluetooth (Nordic UART) as binary base64 frames when connected (live T1), and logs compact PPG-only frames (T2) to flash when offline — wear overnight, then sync the whole night on the next connect. A laptop (Titan bridge) or Gadgetbridge forwards to the Titan ingestion API where all HRV/sleep DSP runs.
